# 📖 Tome III Act 9: The Seventh Capital
**act** · shared · narrative

C55 — Privacy as the Seventh Capital. Privacy is foundational alongside the six classical capitals; character re-typed 2026-07-17: land-based rentier capital, data as soil — rent by position, leased never conveyed, only reputation compounds. Resonance mana register opens (🔭 · the 7th Capital in motion).
